DIAGNOSIS
STEP 1. Check the power window main switch continuity.
(1) Remove the power window main switch. (Refer to P.42-71.)
(2) Check the continuity when the power window main switch is 
turned to the UP position or DOWN position.
Q: Is the power window main switch damaged?
YES : Replace it, then go to Step 4.
NO : Go to Step 2.
STEP 2. Check the front power window motor <LH> 
operation.
(1) Remove the power window motor <LH>. (Refer to P.42-74.)
(2) Connect a battery directly to the motor terminals and check 
that the motor runs smoothly.
Q: Is the front power window motor <LH> damaged?
YES : Replace it, then go to Step 4.
NO : Go to Step 3.
